metadata.case_name: CHAN KAM HONG v. MOHAMMAD RIAZ

plaintiff.occupation_before: Sole proprietor of a car repair and maintenance business called Shun Yong Motor Cars Co.
plaintiff.occupation_after: Continued to operate Shun Yong Motor Cars Co. (with reduced efficiency)

injuries.description: Degenerative changes of the lumbar spine at L2/3, L3/4 and L4/5 (marked degenerative change at L3/4).
source: the X-ray and the MRI of the lumbar spine however showed degeneration at the L2/3, L3/4 and L4/5 levels, and in particular at L3/4 level.

when Dr. Lee examined Mr. Chan one and half years after the accident in November 2005, he noted from the X-ray taken of Mr. Chans lumbar spine that he was suffering from "very marked degenerative change in the L3/4 with narrowing of the disc space, marked osteophyte formation and subchrondral sclerosis."
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Sprain of the right waist / low back sprain from the 16 June 2004 collision.
source: during the collision he sprained his right waist and his right knee hit some hard object.
Shortly after the collision, he started to feel pain at his right waist, and the pain further radiated to the right hip.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Mild osteoarthritis changes of the right knee.
source: X-ray of the right knee showed mild osteoarthritis changes.
Dr. Lee states in his first report that... "X-ray of the right knee showed mild osteoarthritis changes."
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: Sharp pain at his waist with pain radiating to the right hip.
Residual radiating pain at his lower back around the waist.
Not able to squat or sit for a long time.
Easily loses his balance when his right knee gives away suddenly.
Reduced ability in lifting heavy objects and difficulty performing more physically demanding tasks (e.g., spray painting, assembling car parts).

treatments_received: Admission to St. Teresa Hospital (2 days) and x-ray
Physiotherapy (private practitioner and Caritas Medical Centre; 13 sessions between February to June 2005)
Private consultations with orthopaedic surgeons (Dr. Lam, Dr. Lee joint expert etc.)

losses.description: Difficulty in walking stairs; not able to squat or sit for a long time; intermittent limp noted on surveillance.
Reduced ability to perform strenuous car-repair tasks leading to hiring casual labour and subcontracting paint-spraying work and reduced profits of Shun Yong.
